$comment: Part 2 · Stage 7 (S7-entitle): the ONE canonical module / package registry. Embedded by the API (crates/kernel/src/entitlement.rs, include_str!) and imported by the web app (apps/web/app/lib/entitlements.ts). Documented in docs/readiness/ENTITLEMENT_IMPLEMENTATION.md. Changing a package here changes what institutions on that package may use: coordinate with docs/readiness/COMMERCIAL_PACKAGING.md.

modules.name: Student records
modules.description: Student master record, guardians, registration, progression, completion and exit, alumni, document requests, scholarships.

modules.name: Admissions
modules.description: Admission cycles, applications, offers, duplicate-applicant resolution.

modules.name: Academics
modules.description: Course offerings, sections, enrolment, faculty assignment, timetable, internal assessment, flexible learning, academic monitoring.

modules.name: Attendance
modules.description: Teaching-session attendance, attendance policies, corrections and summaries.

modules.name: Examinations
modules.description: Exam policy, sessions, scheduling, registration, hall tickets, marks, results, revaluation, completion.

modules.name: Fees & finance
modules.description: Fee structures, charges, payments and receipts, refunds, adjustments, receivables, ledger, periods, treasury, financial aid.

modules.name: HR
modules.description: Staff records, engagements, positions, recruitment, onboarding, leave, staff attendance, workload, separation.

modules.name: Payroll
modules.description: Payroll configuration, salary structures and assignments, payroll runs, payslips, disbursements, final settlements.

modules.name: Hostel
modules.description: Hostel policies, rooms and beds, applications, allocations, mess, resident leave, inspections.

modules.name: Transport
modules.description: Routes, stops, vehicles, drivers, trips, transport passes and allocations.

modules.name: Library
modules.description: Catalogue, copies, memberships, loans, reservations, fines, clearances.

modules.name: Procurement
modules.description: Suppliers, requisitions, sourcing, purchase orders, goods receipts, vendor invoices and payments.

modules.name: Inventory
modules.description: Items, stores, stock on hand, issues, reservations, adjustments, replenishment.

modules.name: Reporting & accreditation
modules.description: Enterprise dashboards, statutory / regulatory reporting cycles, accreditation.

core.name: Platform
core.description: Sign-in, identities, audit, inbox, notices, to-dos, documents, data import / export, search, workspace catalogue, entitlements. Always available.

core.name: Institution set-up
core.description: Institution, organisation units, positions, campuses, curricula, programmes, academic calendar. Always available.

core.name: Campus facilities
core.description: Infrastructure, spaces, room reservations, service desk tickets, maintenance, laboratories, campus governance. Always available.

packages.name: Academic Plus
packages.description: Core Academic plus fees, library and reporting.

packages.name: Institution Operations
packages.description: Academic Plus plus HR, payroll, hostel and transport.

packages.name: Complete ERP
packages.description: Every module, including procurement, inventory and assets.

api.$comment: Server-side classification of /api/v1/<area>/... requests. Areas not listed (auth, platform, institution, profile, notifications, notices, todos) are core. A rule [needle, module] matches when a non-id path segment after the area contains `needle`; rules are tried in order, then `default` (null = core).

web.$comment: UI-only mirrors (never the control; the API gate above is). routes: first path segment -> module; workspaces: catalog workspace key prefix -> module (longest prefix wins).
